// Less Aggressive AI - overrides AI/StrategyConquest.txt (loaded directly by the engine).
// Generated by build.ps1: vanilla file with each strategy's DefenseGroups block replaced
// by the mod's mandatory-garrison version from src\StaticDefence.txt.

/*****************************************************************************
Each Strategy should include these elements:
0. Strategy name

1. PreferNuclear - a general indication of the effort split between Invasion and Nuclear parts - can be a number from 0 to 100. 
    0 means No Nuclear, 100 means No Invasion.
   Can use the diplomacy indicators:
    WantShareNuclear
    BlockShareNuclear
   Can use the probability weight to influence the probability of this plan being selected 
    Probability X , where X is number from 0 to 10000, default is 100


2. InvasionTechList, NuclearTechList, DomesticTechList - the overall list of technologies to develop.
   The same tech can present in several lists. No need to list the full path to some tech - the parents will be 
   researched automatically, BUT this will influence the granularity of choice between Invasion and
   Nuclear techs
   When selecting what to research next, the AI will first list all "Target" marked technologies within its current tech level or lower.
   If there are some Domestic techs of the current level, only they will be selected. Otherwise either Invasion or Nuclear techs will be selected
   basing on the Nuclear indicator.
   Then one of the selected techs will be randomly choosen.
   If there are no Target techs, then all listed techs will be worked on in the same way.
   If there are no listed techs as well, any tech of the current or lower tech level will be choosen randomly.

3. NoNukeCitiesBefore tech list - the AI will not be starting the full-scale nuclear war until it has these technologies available

4. InvasionSupport - the rules of preparing the invasion dynamically (per region)
   Separate rules for each defined SupportType, potentially different for the normal land-bound regions and WaterOnly regions, that we don't have
   the land connection with.

5. DefenseGroups - faction defence groups.
   Minimal - the static groups per faction. Before having the minimal defense set the invasion will not start.
   ComplementPer - dynamically generated groups based on conditions
     - Complements mean the additional forces over the minimal that are required per region, or per some 
       region GDP value, or per global GDP value. 100% means the faction's full pre-war GDP.
     - by default complements make a part of the minimal set, i.e. no invasion before every complement is built. To change this
       behaviour, use Optional keyword before ComplementPer keyword - in this case the invasion will be still possible before 
       this optional complement groups are built

   Coverage - special type of groups that should ensure the coverage of the whole faction territory

6. EndangeredRegion - the rules of building the defences per region dynamically.
   The same structure as InvasionSupport, but for our endangered regions that we need to defend
   
7. NuclearGroups - the list of units (or unit groups) to start the nuclear war - the minimal set, the target set and the optional set. 
     Minimal set is required to be able to give at least some response on the nuclear attack - the invasion 
     will not start until this set is built - can be null. Having the target set ready triggers the nuclear 
     attack - can be null if the nuclear war is not planned in this strategy.
     Optional set is something nice to have but not strictly required

8. NuclearDynamicGroups - the set of complements defining what to build depending on varying conditions

!!! Note that the technologies required to build minimal Defense, Invasion and Nuclear groups will be automatically
    added to the MinRequired for Invasion tech list, unless the Invasion is disabled (PreferNuclear 100)
    The technologies required to build target Nuclear group are automatically added to the Target Nuclear 
    tech list, unless the Nuclear is disabled (PreferNuclear 100)
    The technologies for Optional units are not automatically added unless "ForceOptionalTechnologies" is specified


*****************************************************************************/

Strategy "Default"
///Invades with a generic army strategy and then uses ICBMs and gravity bombs
  PreferNuclear 50 // from 0 (no nuclear) to 100 (no invasion)
  Probability 100
  
  USE "AI/Default/Tech.txt"
  
  USE "AI/Default/Invasion.txt"
  // --- inlined from src\StaticDefence.txt (USE'd files resolve to the base game) ---
  DefenseGroups
    Minimal  // the baseline force required before ANY invasion is considered
      "ArmyBaseDef" x 2
      "ArmyGroupDef" x 2       // standing home-defence divisions (vanilla: none)
      // vanilla also required "Carrier" x 1 here.  Dropped: the AI does not
      // prioritise building one (saves show SSBNs and resupply ships queued
      // ahead of it for over an hour), so it silently blocked every invasion.
      "Patrol" x 2
      "HiddenPatrol" x 1

    ComplementPer 10 RegionGDP Once // every region worth >=10% of GDP (vanilla: 15%)
      "ArmyBaseDef" x 1
      "AirportTactical" x 1
      "ArmyGroupDef" x 1       // one garrison division per important region

    ComplementPer 1 EndangeredRegion // one division per region bordering an enemy
      "ArmyGroupDef" x 1

    ComplementPer 2 EndangeredRegion
      "LWRadar" x 1

    ComplementPer 8 Regions  // vanilla: 10
      "Airport" x 1

    ComplementPer 7 Regions
      "Satellite"

    Optional ComplementPer 5 RegionGDP Max 2
      "SecurityCheckpoint" x 1

    ComplementPer 10 RegionGDP Once // vanilla: Optional x2; x1 keeps the gate at ~2-3h
      "SAMSite" x 1

    Optional ComplementPer 1 WaterBorderRegion Max 4
      "BestCoastalDefence" x 1

    Coverage Dist 2000 By "Air_Transport"
      "ArmyBaseDef" x 1

  USE "AI/Default/DynamicDefence.txt"
  USE "AI/Default/Nuclear.txt"
  USE "AI/Default/Domestic.txt"

Strategy "Submarines"
